content:
claire: FYI found a plaintext GCP SA key ID in staging partner webhook payloads. payload also had `wrapped_blob: partner-wrap:v2`. redacted the snippet and creating an incident SEC-5044.

josh: can you confirm vault path that reads this blob (no secrets)?

claire: consumer reads `secret/data/partners/ingest`. grep: `/var/log/webhook/partner/*` lines referencing `service_account: partner-ingest@...` and `wrapped_blob: partner-wrap:v2`.

infra: containment plan: 1) pause staging consumer 2) request partner rotate & revoke old key 3) snapshot vault metadata + enable request/response audit 4) transit rewrap of ciphertext and update KV entries 5) apply short-lived RBAC lock on that path. who can own vault ops?

josh: I can take vault ops. steps I'll follow (dry-run then apply):
```
vault kv get -format=json secret/data/partners/ingest > /tmp/partners.ingest.meta
vault transit rewrap -mount=transit partner-wrap-key partner-wrap:v2 --dry-run
vault transit rewrap -mount=transit partner-wrap-key partner-wrap:v2
```
I'll also export the audit events and drop to SEC-5044.

vault-bot: audit: request/response logging on secret/data/partners enabled at 2026-07-12T21:04:12Z.

claire: paused webhook-ingest-staging and notified partner. asked for rotation proof (new key id + revocation).

infra: recommend emergency policy to restrict writes to the path. sample emergency policy provided and will be applied for the window.

josh: dry-run rewrap OK. executing rewrap -> new ciphertext id partner-wrap:v3. updated KV to point to new ciphertext and redeploying consumer.

pagerduty-bot: incident SEC-5044 acknowledged by oncall (tilly).

infra: redeploy started: webhook-ingest-staging v2026.07.12-rc2. rotating our staging service account keys that accepted the webhook. ETA 25m.

josh: QA verified consumer can decrypt partner-wrap:v3 and integration tests pass. no errors in staging logs after restart.

vault-bot: vault-audit: 12 requests to secret/data/partners/ingest recorded during containment window; logs forwarded to sec-audit index.

claire: follow-ups assigned in SEC-5044: 1) add presubmit linter for payloads to detect SA key patterns (owner: devex) 2) tighten partner onboarding docs (owner: partner-ops) 3) run RBAC audit for vault access by partner identities (owner: infra) 4) postmortem in 48h.

josh: dropping rewrap logs + kv update diff into SEC-5044. marking vault work done.

claire: leaving incident open until partner provides rotation proof and our internal key rotation completes. thanks for quick response. :lock:
